# tsk

> tsk is a terminal task board for you and your agents: one shared queue, a TUI for you, a CLI for them.

The human uses the TUI; agents use the CLI. The fork keeps its board, questions, and reports tabs, project groups, one-line rows, parent relationships, and notes status cards. The browser demo is sample data, disconnected from the store, Herdr, secrets, and deployment authority.

## Install

- macOS and Linux: `curl -fsSL https://gettsk.sh/install.sh | sh`, or `brew install smarzban/tap/tsk`.
- Windows 10/11, ARM64 or x86-64: `irm https://www.gettsk.sh/install.ps1 | iex` in PowerShell.
- `tsk setup herdr` adds the board to Herdr. `tsk setup` installs agent skills. Details: https://gettsk.sh/docs/install.md

## Concepts

- Human status is the source of truth. Checking every step never completes a task. Detailed states are open, ready, started, blocked, review, and done.
- Legacy Agent commands accept todo/doing and --todo/--doing. Unprojected list/questions JSON remains an array; list status remains todo/doing/done, including direct lookup.
- A project is a Git repository root. The desk holds tasks with no project. T12, 12, and a task UUID address the same task. N notices are human-only.
- A parent is an optional UUID relationship. Parent completion, archive, or deletion never changes children. Missing parents retain their unresolved link. After prerequisites use task numbers; waiting_for remains numeric.
- Assignment, dispatch, block/review cards, replies, paper trail, and git backup/restore are available. Dispatch needs Herdr and an assigned project task; only an agent assignee dispatches.
- Task labels are grouping metadata. Focusing a working Thread still requires its exact single four-token Thread: notes line; question origin does not imply task ownership.
- The integrated store is v16 and reads fork v10 and upstream v6–v15. UUID after links migrate to task numbers. An unresolved link refuses migration instead of being lost. Back up the full directory and stop all writers before a shared-store upgrade; rollback restores that directory and the previous binary.
- Older done tasks move to dated done files. `tsk list --done --history`, direct task lookup, archived lookup, and task-linked question lookup retain access; historical tasks are read-only.

## For agents

- Run `tsk guide` for the workflow and `tsk help <command>` for syntax. Read with `tsk list --json`; direct lookup includes notes, steps, parents/children, block/review, dispatch, and activity.
- Write with add/edit/status/steps. `tsk notes T12 set Now: "Running CI"` updates one card line under the lock; remove clears a prefix and append adds a line. Read back uncertain writes before retrying non-idempotent actions.
- Use `tsk list T12 --field id` or `--note Now:` for one value; --json returns a scalar/object or null instead of the normal task array.
- `tsk import linear --dry-run` previews one-way import. Parent references are linked only when already imported or created in the same batch. User notes and parent links survive --update.
- Questions require the explicitly assigned non-personal Agent state directory. ask/questions/answer/route preserve reference/draft/answers, expected-revision CAS, append-only corrections, and separate saved durability from notification.
- Shared task data holds shareable question references only. Full questions and approval originals stay in Git-excluded questions-private/. `tsk questions` keeps strict full-record reads by default. Opt in with list-only `--inventory` to include unreadable private records as {reference, unavailable: true}, warn on stderr, and exit 0; their answer state stays unknown. Consumers must handle that marker before opting in. Direct reads and mutations stay strict. See /docs/cli/#task-linked-questions. Ordinary Agent/imported answers do not grant approval; approval binds confirmed user evidence to exact target/action/H/scope/rollback. Same-OS-account UI impersonation is not prevented.
- ui-answer is a user-input entrypoint, never an agent action. secret-result records only set after name-only fnox verification; neither command takes or prints secret values. Consume credentials inside a process with fnox exec. Full JSON and refusal contracts: https://gettsk.sh/docs/cli.md
- `tsk report T12 --file completion.md --json` registers Markdown; report reads it back and reports --unread lists pending documents. Only opening the exact revision in the reports tab acknowledges it. Reports never change status or grant approval and contain no authentication secrets or private question originals.
- `tsk threads` is a read-only Herdr session view. Runtime grouping does not imply a wait for the user and does not read or write task/question data.
- Guide: https://gettsk.sh/docs/agents.md
- Coordinator: https://gettsk.sh/docs/coordinator.md
